prompt: A cinematic film still captures a bustling shipyard dock at dawn. On the left, a woman in a yellow hard hat stands firmly on wet concrete. Next to her, a rusted anchor chain lies coiled in a heavy heap. A man in blue overalls points urgently toward the horizon where a massive cargo ship looms. The woman in the yellow hard hat looks at the distant vessel with concern. In the center, a foreman in a white shirt holds a rolled blueprint tightly against his chest. Beside him, a young apprentice in a grey cap leans forward to inspect the paper. The foreman hands a metal pen to the apprentice for signing. A brown dog sits patiently on a wooden crate nearby, watching the exchange. To the right, an old sailor in a striped sweater rests his hand on a thick mooring rope. A seagull perches on the railing above the sailor, preening its feathers. Behind them, a forklift driver in an orange vest operates the machinery. The forklift lifts a steel beam high into the air. A security guard in a black uniform stands near the gate, observing the scene. A red toolbox sits open on the ground next to the guard. A child in a pink jacket waves from behind a fence post. A cat sleeps atop a stack of tires in the background. There is no smoke rising from any chimneys. There is no water visible in the immediate foreground.
